'''''Melianthus''''' is a [[genus]] of [[flowering plant]]s [[native plant|native]] to elevated [[grassland]] in [[South Africa]], Lesotho, and Namibia. A common name for these plants is '''honey flower''', which is also the English translation of the Latin name.<ref name=AZPLA>{{cite book |last=Coombes |first=Allen J. |title=The A to Z of plant names |year=2012 |publisher=Timber Press |location=USA |isbn=9781604691962 |pages=[https://archive.org/details/isbn_9781604691962/page/312 312] |url-access=registration |url=https://archive.org/details/isbn_9781604691962/page/312 }}</ref> This name also attaches to the species ''M. comosus'' and ''M. major'' that are found in cultivation.

The genus contains up to six [[species]] of [[evergreen]] [[shrubs]]. They have large [[pinnate]] leaves with prominent [[stipules]], and erect [[racemes]] of nectar-rich flowers.<ref name=RHSAZ>{{cite book|title=RHS A-Z encyclopedia of garden plants |year=2008 |publisher=Dorling Kindersley |location=United Kingdom |isbn=978-1405332965 |pages=1136}}</ref> The vegetative parts are very toxic.<ref name=han>{{cite journal|last=Hansen|first=Dennis M. |author2=Olesen, Jens M. |author3=Mione, Thomas |author4=Johnson, Steven D. |author5= Müller, Christine B.  |title=Coloured nectar: distribution, ecology, and evolution of an enigmatic floral trait |journal=Biological Reviews |date=2007 |volume=82 |issue=1 |pages=83–111 |doi=10.1111/j.1469-185X.2006.00005.x |url=http://www.uwinst.uzh.ch/publications/ThesisHansen06.pdf |access-date=1 May 2014 |pmid=17313525|s2cid=21719506 }}</ref>

==Species==
Six species are accepted.<ref name = powo/>
*''[[Melianthus comosus]]'' <small>Vahl</small>
*''[[Melianthus dregeanus]]'' <small>Sond.</small>
*''[[Melianthus elongatus]]'' <small>Wijnands</small>
*''[[Melianthus major]]'' <small>L.</small>
*''[[Melianthus pectinatus]]'' <small>Harv.</small>	
*''[[Melianthus villosus]]'' <small>Bolus</small>
